title: Touch controls docs + full gate + close-out commit (closes TASK-95)
description: Closes TASK-95 (PRD §4.13, SC-6 — the touch feature's end-to-end acceptance + discoverability). TASK-95.1 made `app/tests/e2e/touch-loop.spec.ts` FULLY GREEN (the whole SC-1 loop by touch on the mobile profile, wip commit — its message carries the loop wall time and which land-leg fix was taken) — do NOT redo the spec work. This task does the docs half of the original step 2 (README touch-controls note + the v1-scope / keyboard-only line updates + a virtual-key dev note in the app docs), runs the full verification gate (`npx tsc --noEmit`, FULL `npm run test` with the golden flight fixtures UNCHANGED, the FULL `npm run test:e2e` suite proving no keyboard regression, eslint + prettier on touched files), and lands the close-out: task flags, the LOG.md entry with the loop wall time, the handoff deletion, and the single final `feat(TASK-95): full touch loop + docs` commit. No e2e debugging is expected; if the gate finds a real regression, fix it minimally in the responsible code and re-run the affected specs.

steps.description: Docs: README + app/docs virtual-key note (do this FIRST — deterministic, no flake risk)
steps.details: (a) `README.md` — three factual, short edits: (1) the v1-scope line (~line 17: 'no voice, no touch controls. See [ops.md](…)' ) — remove 'no touch controls' (keep 'no voice' and the ops.md link); (2) the Features line (~line 38: '**Accessibility.** Keyboard-only play, WCAG-AA contrast, scalable text,') — update to reflect that touch is now supported (e.g. 'Keyboard + touch play, …'); (3) under `## Controls` (~line 89, after the existing key table and the 'Controls remap automatically as the flight regime changes' line): a short 'Touch controls' note — the dual-stick flight layout (left stick = thrust + yaw, right stick = pitch + roll, plus the per-regime FIRE/VTOL/BOOST/TARGET/weapon cluster), the on-foot layout (move stick + RUN/JUMP/DROP/INTERACT), the MENU button for chart/warp/ships/chat/settings, and the Settings → Touch controls Auto/On/Off toggle (auto = enabled when the device reports touch points). (b) `app/docs/architecture.md` (the doc that covers the input/prediction pipeline — the 'Seamless-transition design' → 'Prediction / reconciliation' section): a short 'Touch / mobile controls' dev note, one or two tight paragraphs: the VIRTUAL-KEY design — touch projects to the SAME key names the keyboard produces (`TouchInputSource.virtualKeys()` in `src/client/input/touch.ts`) and is merged with the keyboard pressed set via `mergePressed` at the two prediction loops (`effectivePressed()` in `main.tsx`) — so the server, prediction, wire mapping and cheat-resistance are UNCHANGED (a no-op when touch is empty); and the enablement model — `Settings.touchControls` = 'auto' | 'on' | 'off', auto = `navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0`, persisted via the Settings → Controls panel. Keep both docs factual and short — no code blocks longer than a line.

steps.description: Full gate: tsc + full unit suite (fixtures unchanged) + FULL e2e suite + lint/format
steps.details: In order: (1) `cd app && npx tsc --noEmit` — green. (2) FULL `cd app && npm run test` (vitest, ~196 files — includes the touch specs 89–94) — green, and confirm the golden flight fixtures are UNCHANGED (`git status` shows no `__fixtures__` diff — with touch empty the merged pressed set is exactly the keyboard set; IF a fixture changed, the no-op-when-disabled guarantee (TASK-89) is broken: find and fix the merge in `src/client/input/touch.ts` / the `mergePressed` sites in `main.tsx` — do NOT regenerate the fixture). Known flake family (documented across the LOG): 2–3 wall-clock/WS-timing reds per full run with no overlap between runs, green in isolation (e.g. `enter-ship.ws.test.ts`, `persist.test.ts`, `multiplayer-foot.ws.test.ts`, `abuse.spec.ts`, `streaming-benchmark`); for ANY red: re-run the file in isolation once (`npx vitest run <file>`); if it passes, move on — never 'fix' a flake with a code change. (3) FULL `cd app && npm run test:e2e` (all ~56 spec files, 1 worker, per-file dev-server boot; ~15–25 min — includes `touch-loop.spec.ts` (~6 min) and every existing flight/weapon/on-foot/mine/sell spec: the no-keyboard-regression proof). Same flake policy: any red → one isolated re-run of that file; the documented load-flake family (e.g. multiplayer under shared-server load, and the TASK-93.2 isolation artifact: the e2e server is WORKER-scoped and Playwright runs files ALPHABETICALLY, so mining.spec's deposit can be shadowed by inventory.spec's dropped unit in one batch — green in isolation) is handled with the isolated re-run, not a code change. A red that SURVIVES its isolated re-run is a real regression: bisect with `git diff 4c7b84e..HEAD` (the TASK-95.1 commit), fix minimally in the responsible code, re-run the failing spec + the full suite once. (4) Lint/format the touched files: `README.md` (repo root) + the touched `app/docs/*.md` + any code file from a step-2 fix — `npx eslint --fix` + `npx prettier --write`; if a lint/format pass changes code (not whitespace), re-run the affected spec once and re-check `npx tsc --noEmit`.

In order: (1) `.ralph/tasks/TASK-95.json` — both steps `pass: true` (they are already `true` in the file — verify, do not restructure); (2) `.ralph/tasks.json` — TASK-95 `passes: true`; (3) `.ralph/logs/LOG.md` — new entry at the top (newest first, matching the existing `### 2026-10-09 — TASK-…` format): the touch-loop e2e (spec + wip checkpoints 162bdec / 04f3f89 / 4c7b84e / the TASK-95.1 commit: warp force-click fix, which land-leg fix was taken — wiring vs closer-start fallback, legs 6–10), the LOOP WALL TIME `[TASK-95] loop wall=…s` (it is in the TASK-95.1 commit message / handoff), the docs added, and the gate results (tsc, full unit, FULL e2e, lint) with any flake isolated re-runs noted; bump `**Tasks Completed:**` by one; (4) delete the handoff (`.ralph/split/TASK-95/handoff.md`, or `.ralph/handoff/TASK-95.md` if the split left it there). Final commit: `feat(TASK-95): full touch loop + docs` — ONE commit containing only the task's files: `README.md`, the touched `app/docs` file, `.ralph/tasks.json`, `.ralph/logs/LOG.md`, `.ralph/tasks/TASK-95.json` (currently untracked — it is the parent spec being closed, commit it), the handoff deletion (plus any code fix from step 2). The wip checkpoints (162bdec, 04f3f89, 4c7b84e, the 95.1 commit) stay in history — this feat commit is the single close-out commit for the feature (the parent's 'one commit' AC refers to it).

acceptanceCriteria: README updated: the v1-scope line no longer says 'no touch controls', the Features line no longer says 'Keyboard-only play', and a 'Touch controls' note under ## Controls describes the dual-stick flight layout (left = thrust+yaw, right = pitch+roll + FIRE/VTOL/BOOST/TARGET/weapon), the on-foot layout (move stick + RUN/JUMP/DROP/INTERACT), the MENU button, and the Settings → Controls Auto/On/Off toggle; and a dev note in app/docs documents the virtual-key design (touch → same key names, merged with the keyboard pressed set; server/prediction/wire/cheat-resistance unchanged) + the enablement model (auto = maxTouchPoints > 0, persisted on Settings.touchControls)

Full gate green: `npx tsc --noEmit`; FULL `npm run test` (touch specs 89–94 included) with the golden flight fixtures UNCHANGED; FULL `npm run test:e2e` (touch-loop + all existing flight/weapon/on-foot/mine/sell specs green — no keyboard regression); eslint + prettier clean on the touched files
.ralph/tasks/TASK-95.json both steps pass:true; .ralph/tasks.json TASK-95 passes:true; LOG.md entry added with the loop wall time; handoff deleted
One final `feat(TASK-95): full touch loop + docs` commit containing only the task's files — no pre-existing dirty files
notes: DONE (do NOT redo): `162bdec` / `04f3f89` / `4c7b84e` (spec + dev-teleport vel + egress wiring + dead-stick land leg) and TASK-95.1 (warp force-click + land leg + legs 6–10 — `touch-loop.spec.ts` FULLY GREEN; the loop wall time + which land-leg fix was taken are in its commit message / handoff). Working tree at start: clean for all task files.

README anchors: v1-scope line ~17 ('no voice, no touch controls. See [ops.md](app/docs/ops.md#known-gaps-v1-scope-lines)'), Features line ~38 ('**Accessibility.** Keyboard-only play, WCAG-AA contrast, scalable text,'), `## Controls` section at ~line 89 (key table + 'Controls remap automatically as the flight regime changes'). The dev note goes in `app/docs/architecture.md` (it covers the input/prediction pipeline — contributing.md has no input section).

Flake policy: the unit suite's wall-clock/WS-timing flake family and the e2e load-flake family are DOCUMENTED (see the TASK-92/93.2 LOG entries) — handle with one isolated re-run of the red file, never a code change. The e2e isolation artifact (worker-scoped shared server, alphabetical file order, inventory.spec's dropped iron shadowing mining.spec's deposit in one batch) is pre-existing and out of scope.

Timing budget (45 min): docs ~15 min (do them FIRST — done early = safe under any later overrun); tsc ~1 min; full unit ~3–5 min + isolated flake re-runs ~4 min; FULL e2e ~15–25 min (the heavy item); lint/format ~1 min; bookkeeping + commit ~4 min. If the machine is slow, the order above keeps the docs + most of the gate inside the iteration.

Pre-existing dirty files — NOT this task's, do NOT commit: `.gitignore`, `.ralph/prd/PRD.md`, `.ralph/decisions.jsonl`, `ralph.config.json`, ~50 modified `.ralph/screenshots/*.png` (NOT TASK-95-1.png), `?? .gitattributes`, `?? .ralph/ESCALATION.md`, `?? .ralph/logs/t761/`, `?? .ralph/logs/t83/`, `?? .ralph/tasks/TASK-89..92.json`, `?? app/.ralph/`, `?? app/.trace-tmp/` (EXCEPT `.ralph/tasks/TASK-95.json`, which step 3 commits).
